_note: THE curriculum config (Marwa 2026-11-05). The parent's choice (a type, or a private school) decides which subjects show on the home page and which books (tabs, map signs, tests) show inside them. js/curriculum.js applies it to the loaded data; nothing else in the app knows about schools. Books: school = the ministry school book (Lesson, Vocabulary, Questions, Grammar tabs), workbook = the ministry performance / assessments book, booklet = a private school's own booklet. A private school = a base type (its ministry books) + its own subjects and books. New school = one entry in schools. A subject in a list but missing from course.json, or without lessons, shows as Soon.

examBooks._note: Tests stay on the map for EVERY curriculum (Marwa 2026-11-05). Only an exam entry with its own "book" set to a book this curriculum hides would hide.
